headline: Access Bank Appoints New Deputy Managing Director and Digitalisation Head
summary: Access Bank has appointed Oluseyi Kumapayi as Deputy Managing Director for African Subsidiaries and Olanrewaju Bamisebi as Executive Director for IT and Digitalisation, following Central Bank of Nigeria approval.
why: Executive leadership changes at major commercial banks steer operational strategy, regional expansion, and technological modernization.

impacts.name: Access Holdings Plc
impacts.why: Board and executive appointments reshape institutional governance.
